metric.name: gmns_spend
question_answered: How much volume did our merchants process?

sql.expression: SUM(CASE WHEN se_cr_dr_in = 'C' THEN -trans_usd_am ELSE trans_usd_am END)
sql.referenced_query: WITH txn AS (SELECT cm13, trans_usd_am, se_cr_dr_in FROM dw.gms_transaction WHERE trans_dt >= '2026-01-01') SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN se_cr_dr_in = 'C' THEN -trans_usd_am ELSE trans_usd_am END) AS gmns_spend FROM txn

metric.name: txn_count
question_answered: How many transactions did merchants process?

sql.referenced_query: WITH txn AS (SELECT transaction_id FROM dw.gms_transaction WHERE trans_dt >= '2026-01-01') SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT transaction_id) AS txn_count FROM txn
